creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 12, item 2.

Two pre-v0.12 idioms change meaning silently under v0.12 and `rad check` says nothing about either.

**A lone `_` capture now discards stdout.** Older scripts used `_` to drop the exit code and let output reach the terminal:

```rad
_ = $`echo visible-diff` catch:
    pass
print("done")
```

On main, `visible-diff` never prints and the script exits 0. RAD40018 only looks at names that promise a stream, and `_` promises none. The migration guide mentions `_` only for the multi-slot silencing forms. A single `_` target always means "discard stdout" now, so it is worth a hint of its own.

**An escaped `'\\n'` split pattern.** `split(stdout, '\\n')`, written when patterns were regexes, now splits on the two literal characters, so every row collapses into one (len 1 for two lines). RAD40016 does not treat an escaped-backslash-n pattern as regex-looking.

Where: the RAD40018 and RAD40016 checks in `rts/check/`.
title: rad check misses two v0.12 migration traps: a lone `_` capture and a `'\\n'` split pattern
